name: Do I need permits for my remodeling project?

mainEntity.name: Do I need permits for my remodeling project?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your project involves structural changes, electrical, plumbing, or HVAC updates, permits and inspections are usually required by local authorities to ensure safety and code compliance.
